blocks.content: CUET 2027 Registration Date (Quick Answer)

CUET UG 2027 registration is expected to begin between February and March 2027. Based on previous National Testing Agency (NTA) schedules, the CUET 2027 application form is likely to be released in the first quarter of 2027, while the last date to apply may fall in March 2027. Students should keep all required documents ready and regularly check the official CUET portal for announcements.

This article is updated regularly based on official announcements and previous CUET examination schedules. Students should bookmark this page to stay informed about the latest CUET 2027 registration updates and important deadlines.
CUET 2027 Registration Date at a Glance

Students planning to appear for the Common University Entrance Test (CUET UG) 2027 must stay updated with the latest CUET 2027 registration date, application process, and important deadlines. Missing even a single deadline can prevent candidates from applying for admission to top universities such as Delhi University, Banaras Hindu University, Jawaharlal Nehru University, Jamia Millia Islamia, Allahabad University, and many other institutions that accept CUET scores. This guide covers everything students need to know regarding CUET 2027 registration, eligibility, application form dates, correction windows, exam schedule, and important instructions.
CUET 2027 Registration Date (Expected Schedule)

The National Testing Agency (NTA) is expected to release the CUET 2027 application form during the first quarter of 2027. While official dates will be announced later, students should begin preparation early and keep all required documents ready.
CUET Registration Dates: Previous Year Trends

The expected CUET 2027 registration schedule is based on registration timelines observed in previous years. Reviewing historical trends helps students estimate when the application process is likely to begin.
Although NTA has not officially announced the CUET 2027 registration date, historical trends suggest that the registration window is likely to open during February or March 2027.
Why Is the CUET Registration Date Important?

Thousands of students miss admission opportunities every year due to incomplete applications, payment failures, or missed deadlines. Knowing the CUET registration schedule helps students complete applications on time, choose the correct subjects, upload documents correctly, and avoid last-minute technical issues.
Who Can Apply for CUET 2027?

Students appearing for Class 12 board examinations in 2027 or those who have already passed Class 12 from a recognized board can apply for CUET UG 2027. Individual universities may have additional eligibility requirements regarding minimum marks, subject combinations, and reservation criteria.
Expected CUET 2027 Registration Fees

The official CUET 2027 registration fee has not yet been announced. Students can expect NTA to release the category-wise fee structure along with the official notification. Registration fees generally vary based on category and number of subjects selected.
How to Fill CUET 2027 Application Form

blocks.alt: CUET 2027 Application Process Step by Step

blocks.content: The CUET registration process is completed online. Students should carefully follow all instructions while filling out the application form.
Choosing the Right Subjects During CUET Registration

Selecting the correct subjects is one of the most important parts of the CUET application process. Students should carefully check university-specific eligibility criteria before finalizing subjects. Choosing the wrong subject combination may affect admission eligibility even if a candidate achieves a high score.
Documents Required for CUET 2027 Registration
Before starting the application process, students should keep all required documents ready to ensure a smooth registration experience.
Top Mistakes to Avoid During CUET 2027 Registration

Students often select incorrect subjects, upload unclear photographs, enter incorrect personal information, use inactive email addresses, or fail to complete fee payment successfully. Every detail should be verified carefully before final submission.
How to Prepare Before Registration Opens

Students should research their target universities, understand course eligibility criteria, decide subject combinations, gather required documents, and begin CUET preparation well before registration begins. Early planning helps avoid confusion during the application process.
What Happens After CUET Registration?

After registration closes, students can make corrections during the correction window if allowed. The NTA then releases the exam city slip, admit card, conducts the examination, publishes answer keys, announces results, and universities begin counseling and admission processes.

items.question: When will CUET 2027 registration start?
items.answer: The registration process is expected to begin in February 2027. Students should wait for the official notification from NTA.

items.question: When will the CUET 2027 application form be released?
items.answer: The CUET 2027 application form is expected to be released by the NTA around February 2027. The exact release date will be confirmed in the official CUET UG 2027 notification on cuet.nta.nic.in.

items.question: What is the last date to fill the CUET 2027 form?
items.answer: The last date to fill the CUET 2027 registration form is expected to be in March 2027. Students should apply well before the deadline to avoid last-minute payment failures or technical issues.

items.question: When should I start filling the CUET 2027 form?
items.answer: Start the CUET 2027 form as soon as the registration window opens, which is expected in February 2027. Keep your passport-size photo, signature, Class 10 marksheet, and a valid email and mobile number ready in advance.

items.question: Can I edit my CUET application form after submission?
items.answer: Yes, NTA generally provides a correction window during which eligible details can be modified.

items.question: Is CUET mandatory for Delhi University admission?
items.answer: Most undergraduate admissions at Delhi University are conducted through CUET scores.

items.question: Can Class 12 appearing students apply for CUET 2027?
items.answer: Yes, students appearing in Class 12 board examinations in 2027 can apply.

items.question: What happens if I miss the CUET registration deadline?
items.answer: Candidates who miss the registration deadline generally cannot apply unless NTA extends the application period.

items.question: Will NTA extend the CUET 2027 registration date?
items.answer: Any extension of the registration deadline depends entirely on NTA. Students should not rely on a possible extension and should complete the application process before the official deadline.

items.question: Can I register for CUET 2027 after the last date?
items.answer: No. Once the registration window closes, candidates generally cannot submit a fresh application unless NTA officially announces an extension.

items.question: How many subjects can I choose in CUET 2027?
items.answer: The number of subjects allowed will be specified in the official CUET 2027 information bulletin released by NTA.

items.question: Where can I fill the CUET 2027 application form?
items.answer: The CUET 2027 application form will be available online through the official CUET portal operated by NTA.

items.question: Do I need Class 12 marks to register for CUET 2027?
items.answer: Students appearing for Class 12 examinations in 2027 can register for CUET without having their final Class 12 results at the time of application.
